questions.prompt: Show each course title and how many students are enrolled in it, including courses with no students. Most students first; break ties by title A–Z.
questions.answerSql:
SELECT c.title, COUNT(e.student_id) AS enrolled
FROM courses c
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY enrolled DESC, c.title;
